slides.heading: What is a set?
slides.body: A set is a well-defined collection of objects. Objects are called elements.

slides.heading: Roster vs description
slides.body: Roster: {1,2,3}. Description: {x | x is a positive integer less than 4}.

slides.heading: Subset
slides.body: A ⊆ B if every element of A is also in B.

slides.heading: Worked idea
slides.body: If A={1,2} and B={1,2,3}, then A ⊆ B but B ⊈ A.

slides.heading: Try this
slides.body: Is ∅ a subset of every set? Yes.

slides.heading: Relation vs function
slides.body: A function assigns exactly one output to each input.

slides.heading: Domain and range
slides.body: Domain: allowed inputs. Range: actual outputs.

slides.heading: Vertical line test
slides.body: A graph is a function if no vertical line hits it more than once.

slides.heading: Worked idea
slides.body: f(x)=2x+1. f(3)=7. Domain: all real x.

slides.heading: Try this
slides.body: Is x² a function of x? Yes.

slides.heading: Slope-intercept
slides.body: y = mx + b. m = slope; b = y-intercept.

slides.heading: Slope meaning
slides.body: Rise over run. Positive → uphill; negative → downhill.

slides.heading: Parallel & perpendicular
slides.body: Parallel: same slope. Perpendicular: product of slopes = −1.

slides.heading: Standard form
slides.body: y = ax² + bx + c, a ≠ 0. Graph is a parabola.

slides.heading: Vertex
slides.body: x = −b/(2a). Opens up if a>0, down if a<0.

slides.heading: Try this
slides.body: Vertex of y=x²−4x+3 is at x=2.

slides.heading: Log laws
slides.body: log(xy)=log x+log y; log(x/y)=log x−log y.

slides.heading: Profit and loss
slides.body: Profit = SP − CP when SP > CP.

slides.heading: SI base units
slides.body: Length m, mass kg, time s, current A.

slides.heading: Speed vs velocity
slides.body: Speed is scalar; velocity is vector (has direction).

slides.heading: Try this
slides.body: If velocity is constant, acceleration is zero.

slides.heading: Cell theory
slides.body: All living things are made of cells; cells come from cells.

slides.heading: Prokaryote vs eukaryote
slides.body: Prokaryotes lack a nucleus; eukaryotes have one.

slides.heading: Worked idea
slides.body: Plant cells have cell wall and chloroplasts; animal cells do not.

slides.heading: Autotroph vs heterotroph
slides.body: Autotrophs make food; heterotrophs consume it.

slides.heading: Worked idea
slides.body: Enzymes break large food molecules into small ones.

slides.heading: Try this
slides.body: Carbohydrates are a main energy source.

slides.heading: Circulatory system
slides.body: Heart pumps blood; arteries away, veins back.

slides.heading: Plant transport
slides.body: Xylem: water up. Phloem: sugars both ways.

slides.heading: Atom parts
slides.body: Protons and neutrons in the nucleus; electrons outside.

slides.heading: Atomic number
slides.body: Number of protons. In a neutral atom, equals electrons.

slides.heading: Worked idea
slides.body: Atomic number 6, mass 12 → 6 protons, 6 neutrons, 6 electrons.

slides.heading: Metals vs non-metals
slides.body: Metals left/center; non-metals right; metalloids on the stair.

slides.heading: Trends
slides.body: Atomic radius decreases across a period; increases down a group.

slides.heading: Worked idea
slides.body: Noble gases have full outer shells → very unreactive.

slides.heading: Coordinate bond
slides.body: Both electrons in the shared pair come from one atom.

slides.heading: Worked idea
slides.body: NaCl is ionic; Cl₂ is covalent.

slides.heading: Try this
slides.body: NH₄Cl has covalent bonds in NH₄⁺ and ionic to Cl⁻.

slides.heading: Acid idea
slides.body: Produces H⁺ (or H₃O⁺) in water. Turns litmus red.

slides.heading: Base idea
slides.body: Produces OH⁻ in water. Turns litmus blue.

slides.heading: Try this
slides.body: pH < 7 acidic; pH = 7 neutral; pH > 7 basic.

slides.heading: Balancing
slides.body: Same number of each atom on both sides.

slides.heading: Try this
slides.body: Heating CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂ is decomposition.
